code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated monocytes and basophils, increased D-dimer, ferritin, CRP, and INR, with mildly elevated creatinine and low total protein. These findings suggest systemic inflammation, possible infection or viral illness, and mild renal impairment. The hematologic and coagulation abnormalities, together with hypoxemia, may indicate a severe inflammatory or infectious process; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
